name: Tokyo Imperial Palace grounds tour
intro: A free guided walk through part of the Imperial Palace grounds in central Tokyo, an area normally closed to the public. Online places for a whole month are released at once and go quickly, but some places are kept for people who turn up on the day.

facts.location: Chiyoda, Tokyo; tours start from Kikyo-mon Gate
facts.bookAhead: Up to one month: the next month opens on the 1st at 05:00

statusNote: Read from the Imperial Household Agency's official visit application site.
popularityNote: Not in our keyword data. Estimate: a well-known free tour in central Tokyo, but searched far less than ticketed attractions.
difficultyNote: Reasoning: online places for a whole month are released at once and the popular dates fill quickly; 300 same-day places per tour remain.
bookingSteps: Apply on the Imperial Household Agency's visit website, which has English pages. The tour is free.
From 05:00 Japan time on the 1st of the month before, choose a date and a morning (10:00) or afternoon (13:30) tour.
Enter the name exactly as it appears on your passport.
You get an email with a 12-digit application number (needed to add companions) and a 9-digit permit number.
Applications close at 23:59 four days before the tour.
On the day, register at 9:30 for the morning tour or 13:00 for the afternoon tour. Show a valid photo ID such as your passport; photocopies are not accepted.
visitorTips: Anyone under 18 must come with an adult.
No tours on Sundays, Mondays, most national holidays, afternoons from July 1 to September 30, or from December 28 to January 4.
No booking? 300 same-day places per tour are handed out at the Kikyo-mon gate one hour before the tour, first come, first served. Bring ID.
A free audio guide app is available.
The Imperial Palace East Gardens are a different area and need no booking.

faq.q: When can I book the Imperial Palace tour?
faq.a: At 05:00 Japan time on the 1st of the month before your visit. Bookings close at 23:59 four days before the tour.

faq.q: Can I join the Imperial Palace tour without booking?
faq.a: Yes, if places are left. 300 same-day places per tour are handed out at the gate, first come, first served.

先着順（300名）に整理券を配布し、満員となり次第受付終了。
